cases.name: Patricia Blue
cases.about: She was a retired member of the East Baton Rouge Parish School Board. “I’m just a friend but the family is doing...as you can imagine. On behalf of the family, we wanted to let everyone know that Miss Pat was an amazing mother, grandmother, aunt, sister, and friend. Her passing is an unbelievable tragedy, but we stand in God’s promises and know that she is in his loving arms. We ask for privacy at this time as this is an extremely difficult situation for this family, and we appreciate all the prayers and support as we celebrate one amazing woman,” said Chirsty Solar, a family friend.
